content: We've (Fastly) got a number of security issues to report related to StarlingMonkey of various severities, and we're wondering what the best way to report this to track this for the wider StarlingMonkey team might be. Is there, or could there be, a private starlingmonkey-security issues repo we could have that's private, and can we also have a SECURITY.md for the main SM repo to clarify a process for folks to report these? So far, we've been doing this tracking on an internal repo of our own.
